sn12.54:1.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, telaṃ ca paṭicca vaṭṭiṃ ca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyeyya.
sn12.54:1.3: tatra puriso kālena kālaṃ telaṃ āsiñceyya, vaṭṭiṃ va upasaṃhareyya.
sn12.54:1.4: evaṃ hi so bhikkhave telappadīpo tadāhāro tadupādāno ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ jaleyya.
sn12.54:1.5: evameva kho bhikkhave, saññojanīyesu dhammesu assādānupassino viharato taṇhā pavaḍḍhati.
sn12.54:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, telaṃ ca paṭicca vaṭṭiṃ ca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyeyya.
sn12.54:2.2: tatra puriso na kālena kālaṃ telaṃ āsiñceyya, na vaṭṭiṃ ca upasaṃhareyya.
sn12.54:2.3: evaṃ hi so bhikkhave telappadīpo purimassa ca upādānassa pariyādānā aññassa ca anupahārā anāhāro nibbāyeyya.
sn12.54:2.4: evameva kho bhikkhave, saññojanīyesu dhammesu ādīnavānupassino viharato taṇhā nirujjhati.
